title: Sample Collection for Downstream Molecular Analysis of Microbial Eukaryotes
author: Caron Lab
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.hisb4ee

steps.title: Prepare Materials
steps.instruction: Prepare all washable materials (carboys, filter towers, tubing, forceps) to minimize contamination.

substeps.instruction: Rinse all washable materials thoroughly with 5% HCl.
Autoclave items if possible.
Rinse materials with DEPC water to inactivate RNase enzymes.
Store materials in clean bags or containers and use gloves.

steps.title: Set Up Workspace
steps.instruction: Establish a sampling station in an area with counter space, a power outlet for the pump, and easy access to a sink or drain, ideally shielded from direct sunlight.

substeps.instruction: Line the countertop with absorbent pads.

steps.title: Prepare Prefilters
steps.instruction: Prepare Nitex mesh prefilters (200µm and 80µm) cut to fit 47mm diameter in-line filters.

substeps.instruction: Acid wash and MQ rinse the prefilters.
Place prefilters into the in-line filters.

steps.title: Collect and Prefilter Water
steps.instruction: Collect seawater and pass it through prefilters into a sample collection vessel (carboy).

substeps.instruction: Connect silicon tubing with in-line filters to the water source (spigot or Niskin bottle).
Filter water through the 200µm and 80µm Nitex mesh prefilters (the 200µm filter may be skipped in oligotrophic environments).
Rinse the collection carboy 3 times with a small amount of sample water.
Collect the pre-filtered water in the carboy.
Immediately place the carboy in a pizza bag or dark trash bag to reduce sunlight exposure.

steps.title: Stabilize and Transport Samples
steps.instruction: Move the filled carboys inside immediately to minimize environmental impact.

substeps.instruction: Keep carboys in the dark (pizza/trash bags).
Chill containers using ice packs, especially for samples from depths up to 900m.
For transcriptomic data, ensure the time from filtration to freezing is less than 30 minutes (increase replicates/filters on vacuum manifold or peristaltic pump if necessary to meet this window).

steps.title: Perform Final Filtration
steps.instruction: Filter the pre-filtered sample water through the filtration tower while tracking volume.

substeps.instruction: Rinse 2L bottles three times with sample water.
Fill 2L bottles with sample water.
Pour water from the 2L bottles into the filtration tower (or use a filtration rig).
Track the input water volume (via 2L bottles/graduated cylinders) and output water volume (via trap flask) for each filter.

steps.title: Harvest and Store Filters
steps.instruction: Collect the filters and preserve them for downstream molecular analysis.

substeps.instruction: Stop filtration once the appropriate volume is reached.
Quickly use forceps to gently fold the filter and place it into a 15 mL conical (Falcon) tube.
Cover the filter with RNALater or a DNA/RNA lysis buffer.
Store the tubes in liquid nitrogen.
